component.summary: Sticky notes that live on your desktop

description.p: Desktop sticky notes for GNOME on Wayland. Notes stay on your wallpaper on every workspace, below your windows, and come to the front while you use them.
The default theme looks like a terminal, with scanlines and glow. Paper sticky-note themes and theme files you make yourself are one click away.

ul.li: Shown on every workspace, below other windows
Remembers each note's position and size
Six terminal themes, five paper themes and custom theme files
Undo and redo, and font size per note
English, Korean and Simplified Chinese interface
